description: This Java source file defines the EnumNativeCodeProducer class, which extends CodeProducer to generate native enum definitions in a code generation context. It provides methods to produce enum code snippets, handle wrapper files and buffers, and generate typedefs for native enums based on provided enum definitions and context.

classes.name: EnumNativeCodeProducer
classes.description: A code generator class used for creating native enum definitions in generated code, particularly for integration with C/C++ headers.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Attempt to generate native enum code; returns false as it is context-dependent and handled elsewhere.

methods.name: generateWrapperFile
methods.description: Generates a wrapper file for the enum; returns false by default.

methods.name: generateWrapperBuffer
methods.description: Generates a string buffer containing the native enum typedefs for a given wrapper.

methods.name: generateNativeEnums
methods.description: Generates typedef strings for a list of EnumDefWrapper objects, optionally setting include header filenames.

methods.name: generateNativeWrapperBuffer
methods.description: Generates the native enum struct, labels, and short names into a buffer for a single EnumDefWrapper.
